gloss: all at once, at one time

definitions.gloss: all at once, at one time
definitions.explanation: Doing or happening simultaneously rather than separately.

definitions.gloss: in one go, at a stretch

examples.japanese: {一度|いちど}に⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{食|た}べないで→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{一度|いちど}に⟦{三|さん}{人|にん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{一度|いちど}に⟦{済|す}ませたい→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧。
examples.english: I want to finish it all at once.

examples.english: I went up the stairs two steps at a time.

notes:
{一度|いちど}に means all at once or in one go — doing everything together rather than separately or gradually.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一度|いちど}に + verb: do all at once
- {一度|いちど}に{済|す}ます: to finish all at once
- {一度|いちど}にたくさん: a lot at once

TYPICAL USAGE:
- {一度|いちど}に{全部|ぜんぶ}{食|た}べる: eat everything at once
- {一度|いちど}に{覚|おぼ}える: memorize all at once
- {一度|いちど}に{運|はこ}ぶ: carry in one trip

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {一度|いちど}に: all at once (emphasizes simultaneity or single attempt)
- {一気|いっき}に: in one breath, at a stretch (emphasizes continuous momentum)
- まとめて: together, in bulk (emphasizes grouping)

NOTE:
Do not confuse with {一度|いちど} (once, one time) without に.
